title: "Im not Racist but. . . ": Discovering Bias in the Internal Knowledge of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Generating a knowledge graph of stereotypes via iterative prompt completions, then measuring overgeneralization using toxicity and regard scores, and assessing representation disparity using topic modeling and relative entropy.
